history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A young man with messy, dark hair is taking a selfie in a bathtub filled with white bubbles. He is holding a smartphone in his right hand, angled to capture his reflection in a mirror. His shoulders and upper chest are visible, and he appears to be shirtless. The bathtub is white and filled with abundant, fluffy foam. In the background, a dark wall with some texture is visible, along with what looks like a light switch or a small electrical outlet. A white towel or piece of fabric hangs from something out of frame, near the top of the mirror. The lighting is dim, creating a soft, intimate atmosphere. The color palette is dominated by muted tones of white, gray, and dark brown, with a hint of red from a small object submerged in the bubbles. The overall mood is relaxed and personal.
